svg.title: Helm face: logo placement (1:1, mm)
svg.text: Helm face, logo placement. 1:1, millimetres. Back of the deck at the top.
mark centred on the screen window
Red: engrave (fill, fiber laser, mark to white). Blue: the face's cuts, for reference only. Grey: the cover and its bend lines.
Cover width 139.60. Face front edge = the outside mold line where the front wall meets the face (inside the front bend's radius).
